AWS (17 metric alarms reviewed; 1 in ALARM now; 62 state updates / 31 OK→ALARM transitions in-window):
- DEDUP cyclopean-bloodshot-hoatzin (3276-2f81-8c75-4ddd): known root-disk/Gerrit-offline incident facets. `rebar-root-disk-pressure` flapped OK→ALARM 8 times between 2026-09-01 20:33 and 22:32 PDT, peaking in the 90-91% range before the host died/recovered; `rebar-gerrit-gate-down` fired twice (2026-09-01 15:42 PDT and 2026-09-02 02:05 PDT) and recovered at 07:12 PDT; `rebar-autodeploy-errors` fired OK→ALARM at 07:28 PDT on deploy_errors datapoints during/after host recovery and is the only alarm still ALARM at sweep end. Per sweep instruction, all disk-pressure / host-down / alarm-missing-data / metrics-publisher-gap / reachability facets are deduped to cyclopean; no new outage-facet tickets.
- DEDUP/RECURRENCE c943-1b38-d613-4013 (teenyweeny-courteous-goldeneye): `rebar-gerrit-voter-errors` fired 18 OK→ALARM transitions, concentrated 2026-09-01 12:04-15:16 PDT plus one at 19:39 PDT. Metric scan found 28 nonzero one-minute datapoints totaling 47 voter_errors. No rebar Gerrit/review-bot/CI-bot CloudWatch log groups were present in this account, so triage is metric-history depth only.
- DEDUP/RECURRENCE 7b4a: `rebar-autodeploy-review-interrupts-bound-exceeded` fired twice (2026-09-01 17:04 PDT and 2026-09-02 00:17 PDT), each self-clearing. Same known review-interrupt bound alarm family.
- AWS log-group inventory found only Lambda groups; no rebar-gerrit/review-bot/CI-bot CloudWatch log groups were available for deeper log scan.

GitHub Actions (61 in-window non-green runs reviewed: 48 failure, 13 cancelled, 0 timed_out):
- DEDUP cyclopean-bloodshot-hoatzin: 27 outage/reachability failures. Gerrit Verified Gate runs 33558659396, 33598976902, 33598979591, 33598982442, 33598984764, 33598987523, 33598990647 failed ticket-resolution / Gerrit fetch paths with HTTP 504 while the host was unavailable.
- DEDUP 0b31-aeb5-e734-41c9: Test Suite (mirror) 33577216351 was cancelled but its Windows leg repeated the known `fcntl`/lock signature (`ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'fcntl'` / `NoneType` `.flock`).

Logs confirm Gerrit PATCHSET checkout + patchset-local pytest/lint failures or superseded cancellations; gate working as intended.
- NOT-A-BUG / Dependabot PR-local action pinning: Test Suite (mirror) 33563549853 and 33563553017 on Dependabot SHA bca85bc2f4da failed the repository test asserting `checkout-gerrit-change-action` must be pinned by commit SHA. This is the PR/change under test, not a main defect.
- NOT-A-BUG / patchset-local setup action absent: Gerrit Verified Gate 33576403129, 33577147657, 33578291516 failed because the patchset did not contain `.github/actions/setup-uv/action.yml`; patchset-scoped, not a main defect.
- NEW P2 fab8-3a2b-d966-4e63 (antischool-maize-barbet): Test Suite (mirror) 33574990286 on main commit 5ff99170b5d0 failed before tests across setup-dependent jobs because `.github/actions/setup-uv` has a PowerShell parser error at `throw "Checksum mismatch for $asset: ..."` (`$asset:` parsed as invalid variable syntax). Same signature also appeared on Dependabot push/PR Prompt Eval/Test Suite runs 33575277400, 33575277452, 33575284612, 33575284677. Linked discovered_from this ledger and relates_to 5caa.
- NEW P3 adab-9d5a-7043-42d2 (pathworky-unrivaled-firefly): Gerrit Verified Gate 33580445347 reached `cast Verified` with `WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION=success`, `VOTE_TYPE=success`, change 2483 patchset 7, then failed red because Gerrit returned `error: fatal: change is closed`. Linked discovered_from this ledger and relates_to be9d.
